scope: Source-only provider token-receipt completeness correction. No packaged binary, frontend dist or bundled resources rebuilt. Live campaign remains on original immutable binary identified by parent as 42bd; its old positive partial totals remain observed lower bounds, not complete measurements. This source change is not candidate tuning and must not be attributed to those live outcomes.

productionFiles.qualification: afterSha256 is this accounting-only layer; another independently owned observation-truncation change follows it in the current tree.

contract.tokenAccounting: Optional on engine.Result, Harness SolveResult/Trial.Result and EvalResult. Nil legacy is unknown. version=1; source=provider_terminal_counts; coherent counts; complete requires attempts>0 and every attempt has terminal Done with both explicitly present nonnegative provider token counters. Explicit zero is preserved but nonpositive total cost fails the gate.
contract.gate: costAccountingStatus and costComparisonValid; invalid/partial/unknown costs do not yield supported ratios and cannot activate, even if a stored legacy gate was eligible.
contract.nested: Invocation-local ledger aggregates retries, summary calls, child invocations and workflow checkpoints once; resumed legacy checkpoints retain unknown contributions.
contract.review: Review submission requires unchanged output and equal observed accounting/usage, allowing independent rejection/assessment of partial or legacy measurements. Activation separately recomputes the full current policy and requires complete trustworthy accounting.

coverage: Cancellation, real context deadline and incomplete EOF retain prior observed totals and mark cost partial.
Terminal length failures, duplicate tool IDs, malformed tool arguments, provider terminal error and cancellation after terminal receipt preserve received metrics.
Explicit zero differs from absent/negative counter; invalid status/version/source/counts and aggregate overflow fail closed.
Retry, nested invocation, cancellation while child unwinds, summary generation and workflow resume avoid double counting.
Shared app solver propagates the receipt ledger; stored old eligible gates are denied after restart without rewriting records; failed trials remain in gate denominators.

Unchanged partial/legacy costs permit truthful rejected independent reviews and idempotent resubmission. Changed source/accounting/observed usage cannot be reviewed as frozen evidence. Matching partial or malformed accounting still cannot activate despite a stored eligible gate and approved review.

separateFollowups.rootOwned: Audit event filtering/context presentation and frontend cost labels are separate root-owned source edits.
separateFollowups.agentAOwned: Oversized observation execution-metadata preservation in harness_solver.go is a separate source layer.

supersedes.reason: Root review found that the shared evidence verifier prevented recording truthful rejected reviews for partial/unknown cost. Version2 separates unchanged-evidence consistency from promotion-only completeness. Version1 patch/log/manifest are preserved unchanged.
